collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-40  -  THE EXAMPLE NO ONE SAW SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: A quiet villager finds a damaged basket, scattered seeds and a loose stone beside a path after everyone has gone home.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A quiet villager finds a damaged communal basket, scattered seeds, and a loose stone beside a path after everyone else has gone home.

choices.label: Repair the Basket and Return It to Storage.
Move the Loose Stone Away from the Walking Path.
Leave a Short Note Explaining What Needs Attention.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The basket is ready for use the next morning, though nobody knows who repaired it.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The damage proves too extensive, so the villager leaves it safely aside for inspection.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Most are recovered and returned to a clean container.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The path is safer for the villagers who use it at dawn.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The stone is too heavy, so the villager marks the obstruction for the morning workers.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The morning workers understand the situation and finish the remaining tasks.

b2__fx.name: Outcome B2
b2__fx.text: Some seeds are spoiled, and the villager records the loss for the keeper.
